RagShortTexts: Ulrich I transformed the House of Württemberg from local Swabian counts into an assertive.

Variants.Content: Capitalizing on the fall of the Hohenstaufens, Ulrich I of Württemberg seized crumbling Swabian ducal estates around Stuttgart and the Neckar valley. Flying three stag antlers on gold, the dynasty steadily forged a united southern German principality.
Württemberg retinues absorbed scattered imperial manors, imposing disciplined feudal taxes across fertile Swabian hills.
